premises.text: Indoor growers' sensor notes and yields stay siloed raw data, forcing guesswork, consultant spend, or gut decisions
premises.evidence_span: this is raw data. It doesn't talk to each other, and it doesn't tell Tom anything

premises.text: AgriList aggregates sensor, document, and manual data into one dashboard with graphs and crop task management
premises.evidence_span: With AgriList, all of Tom's data talks to each other, eliminating the guesswork from decision making

premises.text: The platform analyzes operations and recommends actions such as lighting schedules for time-varying electricity rates
premises.evidence_span: AgriList goes a step further and provides recommendations to show Tom when he should turn on and off his lights to achieve maximal savings

premises.text: Subscription pricing around $1,000 per acre per month targets a large and growing global greenhouse acreage market
premises.evidence_span: Our private beta was released at a subscription price at $1,000 per acre per month

value.text: Indoor farmers control operations and profits with easier, data-driven growing
value.evidence_span: helps indoor farmers take control of their operations

secondary_value.text: More sustainable, efficient food production to meet rising global demand
secondary_value.evidence_span: We want to help feed the world

causal_links.evidence_span: being able to control those conditions means being able to control your profits
Agilis aggregates all of Tom's data in one place. Agilis analyzes and makes recommendations for Tom, saving him money
